source_instruction: i am looking for stainless steel hair cutting scissors of 7 inch size.
query: Oh man, I spent 20 minutes this morning trying to get my cat to stop knocking over my potted succulents on the windowsill, and I swear he stared right at me before swatting a tiny echeveria straight onto the rug. I also had to run back inside twice on my way out because I forgot my reusable iced coffee sleeve and then my apartment keys, total chaotic start to the day. I stopped by the food cart by the subway for a breakfast taco too, and they put way too much cilantro on it this time, I was picking bits off the whole walk over. Anyway, I’m looking for hair cutting tools here—needs to be stainless steel, the 7 inch option is perfect, and I’m sticking to that one for the max I want to spend, yeah?
